sources.role: Current Function.update_self computes the same updated coordinate
sources.raw_excerpt:
def update (f : ∀ a, β a) (a' : α) (v : β a') (a : α) : β a :=
  if h : a = a' then Eq.ndrec v h.symm else f a

@[simp]
theorem update_self (a : α) (v : β a) (f : ∀ a, β a) : update f a v a = v :=
  dif_pos rfl

sources.role: PairwiseDisjoint uses Disjoint on the same indexed function
sources.raw_excerpt:
`s.Pairwise Disjoint` is (definitionally) the same as `s.PairwiseDisjoint id`. We prefer the latter
in order to allow dot notation on `Set.PairwiseDisjoint`, even though the former unfolds more
nicely. -/
def PairwiseDisjoint (s : Set ι) (f : ι → α) : Prop :=
  s.Pairwise (Disjoint on f)

variable {f : α → β} {s t u : Finset α} {a b : α}

theorem disjoint_left : Disjoint s t ↔ ∀ ⦃a⦄, a ∈ s → a ∉ t :=
  ⟨fun h a hs ht => notMem_empty a <|
    singleton_subset_iff.mp (h (singleton_subset_iff.mpr hs) (singleton_subset_iff.mpr ht)),
